purpose: Generate same-simulator successful left- and right-arm dynamics for offline world-model training only.
source: public RoboTwin adjust_bottle built-in deterministic motion-planning expert
track2_policy_training: The official Pi0.5, reward model, RL configuration, and RL budget remain unchanged; oracle actions are never used by the policy or at inference time.
episode_selection: scan integer simulator seeds from zero upward and retain the first 128 for which the public expert planner and task success check both pass
split_rule: episode-disjoint hash ranking stratified by active arm; task outcome is not a split feature
prohibited_uses: policy behavior cloning or action injection
validation checkpoint selection using training episodes
